addon.changelog:
NEW
- Surface & Facing section in the sidebar: the Shrinkwrap and Face Object settings, without opening the modifier panel
- The Color, Tint and Surface & Facing sections are also shown in Object mode

FIXES
- Moving any object could make the whole scene stutter when a GPSketch object used a Dots or Box material with a spacing like 30%. It was most visible with Remesh on
- Booleans drawn with the Box, Circle, Line, Arc, Curve or Polyline tools fired before the tool had finished, which could destroy an earlier hole and leave a ragged sliver
- Intersect no longer deletes fills the cutter doesn't touch
- Boolean results along the edge of a hole no longer lose their thickness and opacity
- Undoing after turning a boolean mode on could delete the previous stroke
- A smoothed stroke took three Ctrl+Z presses to undo instead of one
- Booleans no longer print debug output to the console

4.3.changelog:
- Fix Hullsketch being slightly transparent
- Fix for a bug where the alpha of GPSketch brushes would appear wrong due to a bug in Blender
